patterns.note: Asymmetrical grid layout for portfolio items, mixing different card sizes and aspect ratios to create visual interest.

Extreme contrast in type scale, featuring massive, heavy sans-serif display text for the hero name, paired with smaller, legible sans-serif body text and a distinct handwritten script for playful annotations.
High-contrast black and white base palette is energized by a vibrant, almost aggressive yellow-orange gradient used prominently in the hero section and as an accent.

The top navigation bar (dark pill) sticks to the top of the viewport after initial scroll, while the hero section's yellow gradient background appears to be a fixed or very slow parallaxing element as the text content scrolls over it.
Major sections are introduced with large, bold, centered headings, often accompanied by a playful handwritten sub-text or decorative elements.

technique_notes: A fixed or slow-parallaxing background image creates depth in the hero section, over which primary text content scrolls up, maintaining visual interest during initial interaction.
A sticky navigation bar, styled as a dark pill with light text, maintains access to key links as the user scrolls down the page.
Portfolio items are presented in a dynamic, masonry-like grid layout with varying card sizes, allowing for diverse content presentation and visual rhythm.

design_tokens.type_scale: Extremely oversized, heavy sans-serif display headings (~8-10x body) with standard sans-serif body text and small, playful handwritten annotations.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners on most interactive elements and cards, with a distinct pill shape for primary buttons and the navigation bar.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and a more compact, but still breathable, grid for portfolio items.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its audacious use of extremely oversized, heavy typography for the designer's name, paired with a vibrant, almost aggressive yellow-orange gradient background that commands attention. This bold, high-contrast aesthetic is playfully softened by the unexpected inclusion of a handwritten script font for annotations and a unique 3D-rendered 'Connect' button, creating a memorable blend of professional authority and approachable personality.
